# Green Woody Home
> Private eco-friendly villa in Castel di Decima, inside the Decima Malafede Nature Reserve, Rome: 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 120 m² living space, 1,500 m² private garden, fully solar-powered. About 30 minutes from central Rome and 15 minutes from the sea (Torvaianica). Sleeps up to 8 guests. Also hosts private events for up to 100 guests.

## Pages (Italian is the default language; English versions live under /en)
- [Home](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/) · [EN](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/en): Overview of the villa, points of interest and distances
- [Galleria](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/galleria) · [EN](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/en/gallery): Photos of bedrooms, bathrooms, living room, kitchen and garden
- [Servizi](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/servizi) · [EN](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/en/services): Amenities (Wi-Fi, parking, EV charger, air conditioning) and local experiences
- [Eventi](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/eventi) · [EN](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/en/events): Villa for parties and events inside the Decima Malafede Nature Reserve, Rome. Up to 100 guests; from €500 up to 50 guests, €10 per extra guest up to 100; overnight stay for up to 6 from €150/night; catering, rentals and set-ups not included; music until midnight
- [Prenotazioni](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/prenotazioni) · [EN](https://www.greenwoodyhome.com/en/reservations): Direct booking request and availability calendar
